sources.name: Nova.rs

Источник media; идёт обычным путём новости (две независимые проверки, не высокорисковые темы, ссылка на оригинал и собственный пересказ); к владельцу попадает то, что не вышло, с пояснением.

sources.name: Vlada Republike Srbije — Vesti
sources.reason: Official Government of Serbia news pages. Production integration is intentionally direct-link only: a private tip must contain an exact HTTPS /vest/<id> article URL, the full article is fetched independently, and an explicit publication date is required. feed_url is a fixed official verification article used only by source-health; it is not crawled as a discovery feed. The source is high-risk, so political material remains owner-review gated even though the source itself is eligible for editorial processing.
